title: chrysanthemum haussknechtii
intro: Chrysanthemum haussknechtii, commonly known as the Haussknecht's Chrysanthemum, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family that is native to the mountains of Iran. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including the potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum haussknechtii include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties, which can contribute to its potential uses in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may be responsible for its pharmacological effects.
